label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said expectations are unclear. What is happening?

Every country team emails saying their invoices are urgent, and last Tuesday when both Vietnam and Thailand demanded same-day payment, I chose wrong and my lead was unhappy. Without a clear priority order, I waste time asking around and end up missing my daily quota by about 20 invoices.

Here is what I will tell HR: The new hire lacks a clear priority order for urgent invoices from multiple country teams, leading to missed daily quotas.
